item.title: Central Province presents K345 million 2026 Budget
item.description: The Central Provincial Government has presented its 2026 Budget totaling K345 million to Treasurer Ian Ling-Stuckey, outlining an ambitious plan aimed at strengthening governance, expanding development in rural communities, and improving financial independence for the province. Presenting the budget was the Governor Rufina Peter, who was joined by Acting Provincial Administrator Bala Kapa, Advisor for Finance and Administration Tony Gamata, and Provincial Finance Manager Walis Imbal. item.title: Buimo prison struggles with staff and supply shortages
item.description: Lae’s Buimo Correctional Institution is struggling to cope with a growing number of inmates, according to court documents presented in court on Monday. Chief Superintendent Michael Wundia, the prison commander, told Lae District Court Magistrate Nasiling Bingtau on Monday that the facility, built for 600 prisoners, is currently holding around 1,070 detainees and remandees. item.title: PNG and QLD Parliaments renew decade-long partnership
item.description: THE Papua New Guinea Parliament and the Queensland Parliament have formally renewed their Parliamentary Partnership Agreement, reaffirming a decade-long commitment to cooperation, institutional strengthening, and regional parliamentary diplomacy. item.title: 100 students inducted into Pathfinder Club at Ragiampun SDA Primary
item.description: More than 100 students were officially inducted into the Pathfinder Club during a special ceremony held today at Ragiampun SDA Primary School in Umi LLG, Markham District, Morobe Province.
